title: Grand Improved Workbench
text: The grand improved workbench allows you to craft special items such as upgraded consumables and anchoring emblems. Grand Improved Workbench at Marianople Community Center They can be found at the following zones' community center when it has reached level 3 development: West Marianople Sanddeep Halcyona Hellswamp East Falcorth Plains Windscour Savannah Rookborne Basin
html:
The grand improved workbench allows you to craft special items such as upgraded consumables and anchoring emblems.

They can be found at the following zones' community center when it has reached level 3 development:

West

  • Marianople
  • Sanddeep
  • Halcyona
  • Hellswamp

East

  • Falcorth Plains
  • Windscour Savannah
  • Rookborne Basin
